checks.name: physical boss melee receives ordinary parry once; magic does not consume parry
ordinary guard redirects one physical boss contact and preserves intended-target attribution
actual iceclaw contact freezes the intercepting guard rather than the protected target
physical boss projectiles use target armor; magic and melee do not
ordinary active aegis reduces physical boss projectiles after armor
dormant ward/barrier defenses accept boss projectiles and ignore retired splash metadata
ordinary reflection applies once to boss direct/melee/projectile, never periodic or counter damage
dormant contact counter triggers only on physical boss melee and cannot recurse
physical boss contacts can mark ordinary followup support without using a retired boss multiplier
legacy source root/exposure/healing block/lifesteal/repulsion/followup cannot stack on boss contacts
exposure amplifies boss direct and physical contacts exactly once, excluding periodic/counters
cyanrise checks actual projectile delivery, not old source projectile metadata
actual production ability casts preserve mixed physical/magic delivery distinctions

notes: Synthetic ordinary defense properties are used only for dormant contact-counter, ward and barrier branches, which have no remaining ordinary roster provider. All damage uses production combatStep.
